name: Factor Bikes
verdict: Factor Bikes has been led by CEO Rob Gitelis since about 2016; in 2025 Zhonglu Co's subsidiary took 21.15% and VSI Cycling 31.72% — a joint majority. Nothing found.
note: High-end carbon bike maker (factories in Taichung, Taiwan and China); bike partner and sleeve sponsor of the 2026 kit. No single controlling owner is documented: per Bicycle Retailer and Industry News (2025-03-10), VSI Cycling Limited (31.72%) and Zhonglu Advantage Global Investment (21.15%, part of Shanghai-listed Zhonglu Co) jointly acquired a majority from exiting non-management shareholders, while the same article states Factor 'has been owned and led since about 2016 by Gitelis'. Zhonglu is a Chinese listed company; no state control documented and no human-rights finding found.
